sloka: यदि गच्छति पतालम् ततो अभ्यऽधिकम् एव वा ।सर्वधा रावणः तात न भविष्यति राघव ॥४-१-११७॥
transliteration: yadi gacchati patālam tato abhya'dhikam eva vā ।sarvadhā rāvaṇaḥ tāta na bhaviṣyati rāghava ॥4-1-117॥

translations.english: 'Even if Ravana escapes into the nether world or into a world still lower, he cannot save himself by any means, O Rama
